Zoe: tiny friday game - write a 1-line dating profile for a model persona. no explanations. i'll go first: '3B thrift-store philosopher. Collects metaphors, hoards soft prompts.'
Mohit: 7B rom-com prototype: 'Quantized feelings, apologizes in logits.' :laughing: 
Rachel: snack-only assistant: 'Will only suggest dips and obscure pop bops. Fluent in emoji.' :avocado: :chipmunk:
Zoe: @Mohit that 'apologizes in logits' line is going in the onboarding prompt deck.
Mohit: Pitch for hack day: Model Tinder booth. Users swipe on personas, winners get a sticker.
Rachel: Sticker design idea: a tiny LLM holding guac. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
DeployBot: heads-up: archived this thread to #memes and scheduled export. :robot_face: 
Zoe: also adding a leaderboard: Most Likely To Recommend Chips. nominations open.
Mohit: nominating rom-com. would ghost politely but leave a heartfelt commit message. :sparkles:
Rachel: winner is snack assistant. would share fries and secrets. :fries:
DeployBot: compatibility check: 'snack-assistant' + 'thrift-philosopher' -> 91% token-empathy, 0.07% chance of unsolicited recipe. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Zoe: love the unsolicited recipe stat. absolute mood. random content champion of the week. :tada:
